description: Up to eight renewable $20,000 scholarships ($5,000 a year) for Gaston County seniors, selected by a committee of Gastonia civic clubs.
eligibility_text: Seniors in public or private high schools in Gaston County who are also Gaston County residents; U.S. citizens; eligible only in the year they graduate. Judged on purpose in life, financial need, character, leadership, activities, and scholastic achievement. Applications open in winter/early spring. 2026 application: due to the school counselor by February 19, 2026 (February 21 in 2025); needs a 300-word statement, a parent letter on finances, two recommendation letters (school; religious/business/civic), and a transcript.
